content.text: Dark page, lots of English letters... but "ת"א-125" is already chosen, white. That's what I came for. "סכום היום 10,000", "הפקדה חודשית 500" — boxes I can type in.

content.thinking:
Claude's narration is a note about a screen with figures, and the text is in Hebrew. Claude is noting that a deposit of 70,000 appears, a figure of 86,045 shekels is shown as the cheaper option, and some terms like "דמי משמרת" and "איביאי מחקה" are unfamiliar.

הצגתי את הסכום שהופקד, 70,000, ואת הסכום הגדול, 86,045 ₪, שמסומן כ"הבחירה שלכם · הזול", אבל כמה מונחים כמו "דמי משמרת" ו"איביאי מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)" לא ברורים לי.
The list starts with פסגות at 86,045, followed by לאומי at 82,968 and הפועלים at 81,052, with the big banks lower; I trust the bank names, though פסגות tops the list as the cheapest.

content.text: The rest give much less, red lines. I'm tired. Still don't know which fund — one more screen.

content.thinking: Claude writes: The Hebrew fund listing shows a 0.1% management fee, but the figures below it are negative: -0.04% and -1,030 ₪. I'm stopping here so you can check whether these losses are real.

input.answer: The page says to hold it at פסגות and buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" (number 5112628), and with 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month you'd have about 86,045 ₪ after ten years. But I don't really understand what I'd be buying, the minus signs worry me, and I'd call you before I did anything.

stuck.why: A dark page with English letters (MSCI, S&P 500, נאסד"ק). It nearly felt not for me, but ת"א-125 was already picked, so I stayed.
The '−1,030 ₪' minus made me back away from that one, and I didn't understand what a 'זוג' is.
'−0.04%' with 'בשנה · שנה אחת'. Does that mean the fund I'm meant to choose lost money? It frightened me.
A long list full of numbers and coloured bars. I got tired and anxious.
